title: gossipframe
summary: Generic Gossip now matches current Benilla's flow and row presentation: message/options/quest decode, per-open weighted and NPC-gender-selected macro-expanded greeting, ask-once eight-block text-record cache, authored shell/title/rows, exact 0..13 option icon table with auctioneer missing-art fallback, ActiveQuestIcon versus AvailableQuestIcon pool split, coded-option disable, route classification, quest query/completion fork, Goodbye and close. The outer frame consumes the observer-resolved registered GossipFrame panel seat; GossipUiLaw owns the 384x512 dimensions, 300x334 clipped greeting/list viewport, row height/content range, overflow-only 16px scrollbar furniture, wheel/drag clamp, and close/action seats.
